Getting started

Install the environment, load tasks, and understand the shared robot interface.

Environment

conda create -n ms3 python=3.10
conda activate ms3
python -m pip install datasets "lerobot==0.4.0"
python -m pip install --upgrade mani_skill gymnasium tyro swanlab h5py tensorboard

The benchmark follows the ManiSkill registration model: importing a task module registers its Gym environment and robot agents.

Create a canonical task

import gymnasium as gym
import task.office_mouse

env = gym.make(
    "SharpaAngledClickMouse-v1",
    robot_uids="panda_sharpa_hand_right_angled_mobile_base",
    obs_mode="state",
    control_mode="pd_joint_pos",
)
obs, info = env.reset(seed=10001)

Action layout

Single-arm tasks concatenate 7 Panda arm targets and 22 Sharpa hand targets. Bimanual tasks use left arm, right arm, left hand, right hand for 58 total targets.
